```
module inventory.reorder
  purpose: Report products whose stock has fallen below their reorder level.

import std.console
import std.environment
import std.filesystem
import std.json

public type Product
  purpose: A stocked product with its reorder threshold.
  has name: Text
  has stock: Integer
  has reorder_level: Integer
  can FromJson
end

public type AppError is one of
  MissingPath
  Unreadable(detail: Text)
  BadJson(detail: Text)
end

public function low_stock(products: List of Product)
  returns List of Product
  purpose: Keep products whose stock is below their reorder level, lowest stock first.
  tags: inventory
  example: low_stock([Product(name: "Bolt", stock: 2, reorder_level: 5), Product(name: "Nut", stock: 9, reorder_level: 5)]) is [Product(name: "Bolt", stock: 2, reorder_level: 5)]
  example: low_stock([Product(name: "Nut", stock: 4, reorder_level: 5), Product(name: "Bolt", stock: 1, reorder_level: 5)]) is [Product(name: "Bolt", stock: 1, reorder_level: 5), Product(name: "Nut", stock: 4, reorder_level: 5)]

  let low be
    for each product in products
    where product.stock is less than product.reorder_level
    sorted by product.stock
    collect product
  return low
end

public function describe_line(product: Product)
  returns Text
  purpose: Format one product as a single report line.
  tags: inventory
  example: describe_line(Product(name: "Bolt", stock: 2, reorder_level: 5)) is "Bolt: 2 in stock, reorder at 5"

  return "{product.name}: {product.stock} in stock, reorder at {product.reorder_level}"
end

public function main() or fails with AppError
  needs console, filesystem.read, environment
  purpose: Read the product file named by the first argument and print products that need reordering.

  let arguments be environment.arguments()
  let path_text be arguments.first() otherwise fail with MissingPath
  let path be filesystem.Path(path_text)
  let text be filesystem.read_text(path) otherwise fail with Unreadable(detail: "cannot read {path_text}")
  let products: List of Product be json.parse(text) otherwise fail with BadJson(detail: "not a valid product list")
  for each product in low_stock(products)
    console.print(describe_line(product))
  end
end
```

```
module inventory.reorder
  purpose: Report products whose stock is below their reorder level.

import std.console
import std.environment
import std.filesystem
import std.filesystem exposing Path
import std.json

public type Product
  purpose: A product with its current stock and the stock level that triggers a reorder.
  has name: Text
  has stock: Integer
  has reorder_level: Integer
  can FromJson
end

public type AppError is one of
  purpose: Everything that can stop the report from being produced.
  MissingPath
  UnreadableFile(path: Text)
  BadJson(path: Text)
end

public function low_stock(products: List of Product)
  returns List of Product
  purpose: Keep the products below their reorder level, lowest stock first.
  tags: inventory
  example: low_stock([Product(name: "Nut", stock: 9, reorder_level: 5)]) is []

  return
    for each product in products
    where product.stock is less than product.reorder_level
    sorted by product.stock
    collect product
end

public function format_line(product: Product)
  returns Text
  purpose: Render one product as a report line.
  tags: inventory
  example: format_line(Product(name: "Bolt", stock: 2, reorder_level: 5)) is "Bolt: stock 2, reorder level 5"

  return "{product.name}: stock {product.stock}, reorder level {product.reorder_level}"
end

public function main() or fails with AppError
  needs console, environment, filesystem.read
  purpose: Read the product file named by the first argument and print the products to reorder.

  let arguments be environment.arguments()
  let path_text be arguments.first() otherwise fail with MissingPath
  let path be Path(path_text)
  let text be filesystem.read_text(path) otherwise fail with UnreadableFile(path: path_text)
  let products: List of Product be json.parse(text) otherwise fail with BadJson(path: path_text)
  for each product in low_stock(products)
    console.print(format_line(product))
  end
end

test "only products below their reorder level are listed, lowest first"
  let items be [
    Product(name: "Bolt", stock: 4, reorder_level: 5),
    Product(name: "Nut", stock: 9, reorder_level: 5),
    Product(name: "Screw", stock: 1, reorder_level: 3)
  ]
  check low_stock(items) is [
    Product(name: "Screw", stock: 1, reorder_level: 3),
    Product(name: "Bolt", stock: 4, reorder_level: 5)
  ]
end
```

```
  check result.length() is 2
```
